evaluation: m0 from step0; J1/Q1 and actual material beta/source Os from first completed step1
g_metric: inherited full material gradient minus g_const minus inherited g_prior
work: dot(g_component,m1-m0); negative is alignment with negative component gradient
force_convention: Names g_const/g_metric/g_prior denote gradients. A descent force is their negative.
no_tests: No finite differences, amplitude search, new identity check, optimizer, forward, success label, or recovery predictor.
